content.text:
Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: Strong orchestration signals detected.

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: map API and web failure paths and return affected files, likely boundaries, uncertainty
- independent track 2: identify CI test commands and return targeted tests and remaining gaps
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_mapper
  mode: read-only
  scope: API and web failure paths
  expected output: affected files, likely boundaries, uncertainty
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: CI test commands
  expected output: targeted tests and remaining gaps
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
